questions.stem: Box plot A has a longer box than box plot B. What does this tell you?

options.text: Data set A has a higher median
Data set A has more data values
Data set A has a larger IQR, so the middle $50\%$ of data is more spread out
Data set A has a higher maximum

questions.explanation: The length of the box represents the IQR ($Q_3 - Q_1$). A longer box means the middle $50\%$ of the data is more spread out.
